correctness.rationale: Let the four adjacent-pair multiplicities be c00,c01,c10,c11. Endpoint telescoping forces c01-c10 in {-1,0,1}. Run decompositions prove the converse realization statement, with the sole zero-transition restriction that only the two constant profiles occur. Summing the feasible loop allocations yields the two parity formulas for Q_n. The singleton classification follows from exact weak-composition counts of loop symbols among forced runs. The bundled verifier independently reconstructs all classes for n=2..16 and checks every observed class size against the run formula; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Read length two is the shortest nontrivial substring-spectrum model. The result exactly determines the largest possible codebook for every block length, improves the generic unrestricted-composition profile bound from cubic order to the exact quadratic count, and completely identifies the zero-ambiguity singleton words. These are canonical finite-length invariants of the reconstruction model, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of a known table.
